fetch-sql-table-and-run-pipeline

17 actions · 14.6s
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const errs=[]; const failed=[];
page.on("console", m => { if(m.type()==="error") errs.push(m.text()); });
page.on("pageerror", e => errs.push("PAGE-ERR: "+e.message));
page.on("requestfailed", r => failed.push(r.url()+" :: "+(r.failure()&&r.failure().errorText)));
await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Fetch table/ }).click();
console.log("clicked Fetch");
// wait for the flagged list to populate
let ok=false;
for (let i=0;i<60;i++){
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  const st = await page.evaluate(()=>({
    rows: (window.ROWS||[]).length,
    flags: (window.FLAGS||[]).length,
    mapKeys: Object.keys(window.MAP||{}).length,
    cards: document.querySelectorAll('#qlist .qitem').length,
    ingest: document.getElementById('ingestBox')?document.getElementById('ingestBox').className:null,
    fileStatus: document.getElementById('fileStatus')?.innerText||''
  }));
  console.log("t="+((i+1)*2)+"s "+JSON.stringify(st));
  if (st.cards>0) { ok=true; break; }
}
const res = await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const perf = performance.getEntriesByType('resource')
    .filter(e=>/\/api\//.test(e.name))
    .map(e=>({url:e.name, dur:Math.round(e.duration), transfer:e.transferSize, encoded:e.encodedBodySize, decoded:e.decodedBodySize}));
  return {
    mapBadgeText: document.getElementById('mapBadge')?.innerText||'(empty)',
    mapBadgeHtml: document.getElementById('mapBadge')?.innerHTML||'(empty)',
    rows:(window.ROWS||[]).length, cols: window.ROWS&&window.ROWS[0]?Object.keys(window.ROWS[0]).length:0,
    flags:(window.FLAGS||[]).length,
    mapCount: Object.keys(window.MAP||{}).length,
    kpiTexts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.kpi, .kpis .k, .statline')].slice(0,10).map(e=>e.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' | ')),
    perf
  };
});
console.log("RESULT:", JSON.stringify(res,null,1));
console.log("ERRORS:", JSON.stringify(errs));
console.log("REQ-FAILED:", JSON.stringify(failed));
console.log(ok?"PASS pipeline rendered":"FAIL pipeline did not render cards");

audit-unmapped-badges

2 actions · 196ms
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const audit = await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('#qlist .qitem')];
  const withBadge=cards.filter(c=>/unmapped/i.test(c.innerText));
  // every element in the whole doc whose own text mentions unmapped
  const occ=[];
  document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(el=>{
    if(el.children.length===0 && /unmapped/i.test(el.textContent||'')){
      let path=[]; let n=el;
      for(let i=0;i<4&&n;i++){ path.unshift(n.tagName.toLowerCase()+(n.id?'#'+n.id:'')+(n.className&&typeof n.className==='string'?'.'+n.className.trim().split(/\s+/).join('.'):'')); n=n.parentElement; }
      occ.push({text:(el.textContent||'').trim().slice(0,120), path:path.join(' > '),
        visible: !!(el.offsetParent||el.getClientRects().length),
        inQlist: !!el.closest('#qlist')});
    }
  });
  return {
    cardCount: cards.length,
    cardsWithUnmapped: withBadge.length,
    cardsWithUnmappedNames: withBadge.map(c=>c.innerText.split('\n')[0]),
    unmBadgesInQlist: document.querySelectorAll('#qlist .badge.unm').length,
    unmBadgesWholeDoc: document.querySelectorAll('.badge.unm').length,
    bodyTextUnmappedCount: (document.body.innerText.match(/unmapped/gi)||[]).length,
    occurrences: occ,
    firstFive: cards.slice(0,5).map(c=>c.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' | ')),
    listHeader: document.querySelector('.listcol h3')?.innerText
  };
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(audit,null,1));
console.log(audit.cardsWithUnmapped===0 ? "PASS zero unmapped badges on flagged cards" : "FAIL "+audit.cardsWithUnmapped+" cards show unmapped");

const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const errs=[]; const failed=[];
page.on("console", m => { if(m.type()==="error") errs.push(m.text()); });
page.on("pageerror", e => errs.push("PAGE-ERR: "+e.message));
page.on("requestfailed", r => failed.push(r.url()+" :: "+(r.failure()&&r.failure().errorText)));
await page.selectOption('select.rca-model-sel', '4');
console.log("model set to:", await page.evaluate(()=>window.RCA_MODEL&&window.RCA_MODEL.model+' / '+window.RCA_MODEL.provider));
await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Investigate Root Cause/ }).click();
let meta=null;
for(let i=0;i<50;i++){
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  meta = await page.evaluate(()=>{
    const m=document.querySelector('.inv-meta');
    return m?m.innerText.trim():null;
  });
  const st = await page.evaluate(()=>document.getElementById('investigationPanel')?.innerText.slice(0,120).replace(/\n/g,' | '));
  console.log("t="+((i+1)*3)+"s meta="+(meta?"YES":"no")+" panel="+st);
  if(meta) break;
}
const r = await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const g=s=>document.querySelector(s);
  const panel=g('#investigationPanel');
  return {
    engineFooter: g('.inv-meta')?g('.inv-meta').innerText.trim():null,
    engineBadge: [...document.querySelectorAll('#investigationPanel .badge')].map(b=>b.innerText.trim()),
    fullPanelText: panel?panel.innerText:'(none)'
  };
});
console.log("=== ENGINE FOOTER (verbatim) ===");
console.log(r.engineFooter);
console.log("=== BADGES ===", JSON.stringify(r.engineBadge));
console.log("=== FULL PANEL ===");
console.log(r.fullPanelText);
console.log("ERRORS:", JSON.stringify(errs));
console.log("REQ-FAILED:", JSON.stringify(failed));
// scroll the footer into view for the report screenshot
await page.evaluate(()=>{ const m=document.querySelector('.inv-meta'); if(m) m.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); });
await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
console.log((r.engineFooter&&/Engine: llm/.test(r.engineFooter))?"PASS engine is llm":"FAIL engine not llm: "+r.engineFooter);

2 actions · 212ms
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const a = await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('#qlist .qitem')];
  return {
    fileStatus: document.getElementById('fileStatus')?.innerText||'',
    mapBadge: document.getElementById('mapBadge')?.innerText||'',
    cards: cards.length,
    cardsUnmapped: cards.filter(c=>/unmapped/i.test(c.innerText)).length,
    visibleUnmapped: (document.body.innerText.match(/unmapped/gi)||[]).length,
    detailTitle: document.querySelector('.rtitle')?.innerText.trim(),
    detailMeta: document.querySelector('.rmeta')?.innerText.trim(),
    detailMappedBadge: document.querySelector('.rhead .badge.ok')?.innerText||null,
    footer: document.querySelector('.inv-meta')?.innerText.trim()||'',
    activeTab: document.querySelector('.nav a.active')?.innerText.trim()
  };
});
console.log(JSON.stringify(a,null,1));
const P=[];
P.push([/66,612 rows/.test(a.fileStatus), "row count 66,612 shown in fileStatus"]);
P.push([/CQN mapped from SQL · 442 queues/.test(a.mapBadge), "mapBadge = CQN mapped from SQL · 442 queues"]);
P.push([/69 multi-queue/.test(a.mapBadge), "mapBadge has 69 multi-queue chip"]);
P.push([a.cards===250, "flagged list rendered 250 cards (cap)"]);
P.push([a.cardsUnmapped===0, "ZERO unmapped badges on flagged cards"]);
P.push([a.visibleUnmapped===0, "ZERO visible 'unmapped' text anywhere in body"]);
P.push([a.detailMappedBadge==="mapped", "queue detail header shows green 'mapped'"]);
P.push([/Engine: llm/.test(a.footer), "final investigation engine = llm (not deterministic-fallback)"]);
P.push([a.activeTab.indexOf("RCA Console")>=0, "stayed on RCA Console tab"]);
P.forEach(([ok,msg])=>console.log((ok?"PASS":"FAIL")+" — "+msg));
console.log(P.every(p=>p[0])?"ALL ASSERTIONS PASS":"SOME ASSERTIONS FAILED");
